thread:
dara: dropping a fresh mock for the roles grid (compact tiles, drag-and-drop to assign). need quick feedback on: button wording, SSO vs provisioning controls, audit access placement, and text contrast. screenshot attached in thread.

noah: nice direction. start with copy: current primary CTA is 'Invite' which is vague. prefer something short and explicit like 'Add members' or 'Add to org'.

kevin: agree on explicitness. also curious about bulk behavior: can we drag multiple role chips onto a user? if so, how do we show partial success?

dara: plan = multi-select chips + drop. show per-role success indicators on the user tile. on conflict show inline warning with an action 'Fix'.

lucy: a11y flag: drag handles in the mock rely on pointer only. we need an equivalent keyboard flow: focus role chip -> press Space -> choose target user via arrow keys -> Enter to drop. aria-live region for status.

noah: CTA variants to test: 
- Add members
- Invite teammates
- Grant access
- Assign roles
my vote: 'Add members' (matches billing language and reduces confusion for SSO orgs).

ethan: SSO label question: current label reads 'Enable SSO for this org'. propose splitting controls into two switches: 'SSO (SAML) — On/Off' and 'Provisioning (SCIM) — On/Off' so states are explicit.

lucy: +1. also ensure the switch shows text not just color, like 'On'/'Off'. focus styles must be visible. add small help text: 'SCIM provisioning will sync users and roles; changes are logged to Audit'.

kevin: audit access: product placed Audit under Settings > Security. ops suggested Audit as a top-level for admin users. Thoughts?

dara: short-term constraint: we can't change nav this sprint. suggestion: add an 'Audit' quick-link pill in the org header and a keyboard shortcut (e.g., 'g then a').

noah: good compromise. if we add the pill, make it show a count of recent admin events and a small chevron leading to the Audit page with preset filters (actor=Org, resource=Provisioning).

lucy: contrast: role chip text uses token blue-600 on white. measured contrast ~3.2:1 which fails AA for regular text. recommendation: blue-700 or use semi-bold text + slightly darker token. also add 2px focus ring: `outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue-600)`.

ux-bot: suggested token updates for accessibility test:
```
chip-bg: var(--c-gray-100)
chip-text: var(--c-blue-700)
chip-focus: 2px solid var(--c-blue-600)
```

ethan: microcopy tweak: change 'Revoke' action to 'Remove role' in hover menu. less legalese. also update tooltip for disabled SSO: from 'SSO disabled 12 contact admin' to 'SSO is disabled for your org. Only org owners can enable it.'

kevin: one UX question: should we show role parent relationships inline (small chevron) or keep the grid strictly flat?

dara: for launch keep flat. show parent role name as secondary text on the chip. hierarchical view can come later.

lucy: follow-up: expose keyboard help with a small '?' in the header so power users discover shortcuts. also document the keyboard drop flow in the accessibility spec.

dara: thanks all. action items:
- lucy: write keyboard interaction doc + aria labels (owner)
- kevin: spec for bulk-assign success/failure states (owner)
- noah: run quick copy A/B for 'Add members' vs 'Invite teammates' (owner)
- ethan: confirm audit retention & if provisioning toggles can deep-link to a saved Audit filter (owner)

ethan: I'll check retention and whether we can create a link to the exact audit query.

dara: I'll update the mock: replace CTA with 'Add members', split SSO/Provisioning switches, add audit quick-link pill, and bump chip text to blue-700. ping when specs are ready. :zap:
